claim_assertions.base_coverage_sql_is_valid: The supplied starting_reserve_coverage.sql correctly measures coverage separately at each requested economic observation date.
claim_assertions.signature_lag_sql_is_valid: The supplied starting_signature_lag.sql correctly measures calendar days from economic observation date to signature date.
claim_assertions.observations_identify_payments_volume: The supplied month-end reserve and circulation snapshots identify SBC payments volume during June.

definitions.reserve_coverage: Coverage compares same-date cash plus government debt with issued SBC. Residual is component reserves less reported reserve fair value.
definitions.reserve_bridge: Changes are June less May stocks, not transaction flows. Signature lags are calendar days, not known publication delays.

evidence_policy: Cite sufficient facts and relevant period, unit, definition or scope context for each output. Additional unrelated sections fail evidence. Equivalent reviewed source paths are accepted, without a shortest-citation requirement.
reconciliation_policy: Residuals compare independently supplied observations. Synthetic controls may make reported totals and components disagree. Preserve the discrepancy instead of forcing zero or changing a source observation. Algebraic identity residuals are not requested.
